goal.title: Solve a Rubik's cube without instructions

task.description: Using the layer-by-layer beginner's method, solve a fully scrambled cube from memory.
task.expected_result: One complete solve from a random scramble without notes, in under 5 minutes.
task.title: Solve a scrambled cube with the beginner's method, without looking at notes
task.why_it_matters: This is the skill the goal is about; everything before it was learning the steps.

expected_output.message_to_user: For this one I'll ask for a short video of a real solve: the app gives you a random scramble, you show the scrambled cube to the camera and solve it without cutting. Then two quick questions about the last layer. A photo of a solved cube wouldn't show anything — any cube can be photographed solved.

methods.instructions: The app shows a random scramble. Apply it, show all sides of the scrambled cube to the camera, then solve it without notes in one continuous recording.
Upload the continuous recording of the practical test.

questions: Which step of the last layer did you do first, and why that order?
What do you do when the yellow cross shows only a line?

pass_criteria: A continuous recording shows the issued scramble being solved in under 5 minutes
protocol.rationale: A skill is proven by performing it on an unpredictable input; the fresh scramble prevents reusing an old solve, and the questions confirm the method is understood.

contrastive.critique: A photo of a solved cube proves nothing — the cube could have been solved by someone else or never scrambled.

output.message_to_user: Just send a photo of your solved cube!

methods.instructions: Upload a photo of the solved cube.
